drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.04737. InteractiveBench formulates benchmarks as horizon-limited interactions between a Player model and an environment or judge, terminating on final answer or budget exhaustion. It defines two families: Interactive Proofs and Interactive Games. Proof settings use a Judge holding hidden ground truth and sparse restricted feedback; tasks include Situation Puzzle, UI2Html, and Math. Situation Puzzle contains 46 expert-curated puzzles filtered for interaction necessity and ambiguity resolution with a 20-round yes/no/both/irrelevant protocol. UI2Html uses 50 expert-curated UI2Code-Real screenshots, an incomplete summarizer description, browser-rendered HTML iterations, and final sub-scores for layout, component, style, text, and polish. Math uses 52 expert-selected HLE problems with reference derivations and sparse claim feedback. Games use Texas Holdem and Trust Game to measure long-term utility.
